Q‑CTRL has announced a new partnership with Quantinuum and RIKEN to advance research in quantum error management. The collaboration aims to develop techniques that mitigate noise and improve the reliability of quantum processors. Coverage of the partnership is being aggregated and distributed globally through Google News via the TipRanks platform.
